_note: Starter glossary. Add terms incrementally as native-speaker spot-checks surface them. preserve=true terms are hard-gated: if present in source, the exact term must appear unchanged in the translation.

terms.rule: Name of the WooCommerce POS feature. Keep in English as the product name rather than a literal calque; Russian translations of this term as 'point where goods are given' have caused confusion.
Point of Sale acronym. Use the locale's established product shorthand when one exists.
Stock keeping unit. Keep as 'SKU' in all locales.
Technical acronym. Preserve when natural; localized descriptions like 'web address' are acceptable.
Payment/card acronym. Preserve when natural; localized script acronyms are acceptable.
Product/admin area name. Preserve when natural.
Use the locale's established commerce term where one exists (e.g. de: Gutschein, fr: Code promo). Do not keep in English by default.
Shipping label flag for hazardous materials. Use the locale's regulated term (e.g. de: Gefahrgut).
